'''Alice's farm''' is a farm located west of [[Port Phasmatys]] and east of [[Canifis]]. It's managed by [[Alice]] and her now-ethereal husband [[Malcolm]]. The farm is involved in the [[Animal Magnetism]] quest and also the locations of several [[undead chicken]]s and [[undead cow]]s. [[Alice's Farming Shop]] can be accessed by either talking or right-clicking Alice.

West of the farm, one can find two [[allotments]], a [[herb patch]], and a [[flower patch]]. Alice's daughter, [[Lyra]], attends the allotments for a payment. There's also a [[tool leprechaun]] and a [[compost bin]].

==Transportation==
* Use the [[Ectophial]] to the [[Ectofuntus]] and run west
* [[Fairy ring]] code {{Fairycode|alq}} and run north (be careful of level 61 [[Feral Vampyre]]s)
* [[Fenkenstrain's Castle Teleport]] from the [[Arceuus spellbook]] and run east
* Take a [[Charter ship]] to [[Port Phasmatys]] and run west
